English.Char_Desc_250: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader for Android supporting 1,000+ websites. Enjoy MP3 and M4A music at up to 320kbps, with automatic cover art and ID3 metadata. Batch downloads and ringtone support make everyday listening easier.
English.Char_Desc_450: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader for Android supporting 1,000+ websites, including YouTube, SoundCloud, and TikTok. MP3 and M4A music are available at up to 320kbps, with ID3 metadata and cover art added automatically. Music discovery covers artists, songs, albums, and lyrics, with URL support for direct access. Batch and playlist downloads, ringtone support, and Bluetooth controls add convenience for everyday listening.
English.Char_Desc_2000: AnyMusic is an MP3 downloader for Android that makes it easy to find and save music from more than 1,000 websites. It supports popular platforms such as YouTube, SoundCloud, TikTok, and more, giving you a convenient way to manage music from different sources on your Android device. You can download music in MP3 or M4A formats with quality options of up to 320kbps. AnyMusic can automatically add ID3 metadata and cover art to downloaded audio files, making it easier to identify and organize your music library. You can also set downloaded audio files as ringtones for quick access on your phone. Finding music is simple. Search by artist, song, album, or lyrics to locate the track you want, or paste a music URL to download it directly. You can preview tracks before downloading to make sure you have selected the right content. AnyMusic also makes it easy to handle multiple downloads. Batch downloading lets you save multiple tracks at once, while playlist support allows you to download an entire playlist without processing each song individually. This is useful when you want to build a music collection or save several tracks from the same source. Once your music is downloaded, you can control playback with Bluetooth controls, including previous and next track functions. Dark Mode provides a more comfortable viewing experience, while risk warnings help you stay informed when starting large batch downloads. The app also includes updated core libraries for improved performance and stability.
